name: CareTrust REIT
outlook:
What CareTrust REIT says to expect

  • Full year 2026: per-share earnings and FFOThe Company increased its 2026 guidance midpoints, raising the low end of its Normalized FFO and Normalized FAD estimates, and now projects net income attributable to CareTrust of approximately $1.50 to $1.51 per share, Normalized FFO of approximately $2.08 to $2.09 per share, and Normalized FAD of approximately $2.04 to $2.05 per share.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 5, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
